source_semantics.reload: The source Sites workspace Refresh control invokes ReloadClickedAsync, which rereads the authoritative site collection and reapplies the current view state.
source_semantics.read_only: Reload is a read operation and does not persist, enqueue, call a provider mutation, or claim mutation success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/pages.tsx binds AIMW-SYNC-A9E956A4DA only to the existing ResourceContent Refresh button when the active workspace route key is sites.
laravel_adaptation.permission_surface: The control remains on the normal Sites read workspace governed by sites.view; it is not nested under the separate sites.manage-only bulk-delete surface.
laravel_adaptation.read_contract: Refresh invokes the existing React Query query.refetch() for the active tenant Sites resource and therefore rereads the authoritative context.api.sites endpoint with the current page/search state.
laravel_adaptation.mutation_boundary: The reload control issues only the existing GET read; RequestBulkDelete, ConfirmBulkDelete, and other mutation controls remain separate operations.
